description: Feature Map for BASTION 90 — ten-minute medieval survivor web game.

features.name: Medieval Catalog, PRNG & Domain State
invariants: Deterministic PRNG produces identical sequences for identical seeds and daily dates
Domain layer has zero imports outside src/domain/

features.name: Ten-Minute Combat, Wave & Boss Simulation Engine
invariants: Engine executes deterministically without DOM or browser globals
The Executioner and Arch-Lich each spawn once, at 270 and 510 seconds of active play
Defeating the Arch-Lich before 600 seconds wins the run and awards a bonus for time remaining
Hero death or reaching 600 seconds with the Arch-Lich alive ends the run and freezes gameplay
Forge choices freeze active time and carry excess XP into subsequent levels
All entity positions remain finite and clamped within arena boundaries

features.name: Procedural Audio, Input, Storage & Game Loop
invariants: All browser APIs (WebAudio, localStorage, DOM events, rAF) remain isolated inside src/framework/

features.name: Stylized Medieval Courtyard, Sprites & VFX Renderer
Web UI Shell, HUD & Level-Up Overlays
invariants: Both game modes start with a 10:00 countdown that freezes during pause and Forge choices
The end summary distinguishes a fallen hero from a timeout
Instant restart resets simulation cleanly without page reload

features.name: Static Dev Server & Deterministic Factory Gate CLI
invariants: All deterministic constraints, boundaries, and tests pass cleanly
